name: Combat HUD
author: ecnamor
description: Unified combat HUD enhancement suite. v2.0.8 (v1.0.15 was the last stable 1.x release). Includes: player ship indicator with damage-reactive ring and directional spikes, battle boundary marker with off-screen flagship pointer, thick weapon firing arc overlay, vanilla HUD hide on overload (with audio low-pass), and killfeed line cap. All features individually toggleable via LunaLib settings.
